## Review checklist

- [ ] The diff is limited to the linked issue and contains no incidental refactoring.
- [ ] Every acceptance criterion maps to evidence.
- [ ] Architecture direction and state ownership follow `docs/architecture/guardrails.md`.
- [ ] Relevant success, boundary, failure, cancellation, concurrency, and lifecycle cases are covered.
- [ ] Documentation/changelog impact was handled or explicitly found unnecessary.
- [ ] Full Release tests and required manual/browser checks passed at the recorded SHA.
- [ ] The latest CI checks are green and review conversations are resolved.
